forces: A single transport-level ECONNRESET on the self-hosted runner reds the required coverage context even though every coverage threshold passed, and the needs: [coverage] edge then prevents the required sonar context from ever starting, so one dropped connection costs two of the ten required contexts and a full pipeline re-run (#345).
approach-sonar-own-coverage.reason: It duplicates the coverage job's three npm ci plus test:coverage legs inside the long-pole sonar job, worsening the makespan measured in #306, creates two producers of coverage metrics that can silently diverge, and still leaves the required coverage context's own upload unretried against the exact defect in #345.

evidence_ids: both upload attempts in the coverage job keep if-no-files-found: error over the exact three-lcov path list, so a genuine absence fails attempt 1 and attempt 2 and the context stays red
both upload attempts set overwrite: true so a partially created first container cannot turn the retry into an artifact-already-exists failure

coverage upload: first attempt carries continue-on-error: true, a 10s wait is gated on steps.upload.outcome == 'failure', and the retry step carries no continue-on-error so a second failure reds the job
sonar download: same shape with id download and steps.download.outcome == 'failure'
the implementation edits .github/workflows/ci.yml only; no new actions, no new .github/scripts files, no dependency manifest changes

security_justification.trust_boundary: Edits run only inside the existing coverage and sonar jobs; no new actor, credential, or trigger surface is introduced, and fork-PR trust boundaries are unchanged.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Does not modify or interact with authority, signing, or provenance logic; the retry steps carry no decision-bearing data.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Does not modify or interact with authentication or authorization mechanisms; the existing job-level token exposure is unchanged.
security_justification.audit_integrity: Preserves every required audit assertion: coverage thresholds, sonar quality gate, and all ten required contexts keep their names and failure semantics.
security_justification.confidentiality: No new secret, environment variable, or data path is introduced; artifact contents are the same lcov reports as before.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Changes are confined to the declared owned paths: .github/workflows/ci.yml and the change directory.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fails closed: if-no-files-found stays error on every upload attempt, the retry step is not gated by continue-on-error, and a real failure still fails twice.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The retry steps surface the action's own standard error output; no new diagnostic path is introduced and no data beyond existing logs is emitted.
security_justification.concurrency: The retry pattern runs sequentially within its own job step chain; no concurrent writers exist for the coverage artifact name, which is what makes overwrite: true safe.
security_justification.lifecycle: Applies only to the CI pull-request and main push verification workflows; no runtime or release lifecycle surface is touched.
security_justification.resource_retention: The artifact container remains run-scoped with the same retention as before; the 10s wait adds at most ten seconds to a failing run.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The change itself is the retry control: exactly one bounded retry per direction on transport-class failures, with genuine failures still failing twice and no unbounded loop.
security_justification.cryptography: Does not introduce, modify, or rely upon cryptographic algorithms or keys.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Processes no user telemetry, personal data, or operational payloads; artifact contents are coverage reports from the repository's own test suites.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Operates within the existing GitHub Actions runner environment with no new external security integration.
